title: Her Husband Said The Bakery Was Failing | One Forgotten Terminal Exposed Where The Money Went
description:
Lena trusted her husband to manage the bakery's finances while she kept the ovens running. When he pressured her to sell, a forgotten payment terminal revealed where months of customer money had really gone.

title: Her Best Friend Stole An Entire Fashion Collection | The Embroidery Machine Kept The Originals
description:
A designer recovering from an injury discovered that her closest friend had claimed an entire collection as her own. The source files were gone, but the machine that stitched the first samples preserved a different history.
